FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The once-majestic halls now echo with the soft hum of synthesizers and the gentle hiss of cassette tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a stout man with a bushy beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional suits of armor, they wear pastel-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

KING EVERARD
(to his advisor, Lord Ravenswood)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. One that blends the grandeur of our past with the... (he consults a worn VHS tape)...futurism of the future.

LORD RAVENSWOOD
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional aesthetic? Our coats of arms, our heraldry?

KING EVERARD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... last season. We must evolve. We must... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's gardens, once a lush oasis, are now transformed into a surreal landscape of distorted, VHS-style glitches. Flowers bloom in neon hues, and the sound of distant, warped synthesizers drifts through the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors, now dressed in their pastel jumpsuits, gather around a makeshift workstation. They frantically work on a new logo, one that blends the traditional symbols of the empire with the abstract, dreamlike imagery of vaporwave.

KING EVERARD
(excitedly)
Yes, yes, yes! This is it! This is the future of our empire!

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

As the sun sets, the castle walls come alive with a mesmerizing display of light and sound. The once-majestic stone is now adorned with glowing, neon-colored hieroglyphics, pulsing in time with the beat of a distant, analog drum machine.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, surrounded by his advisors, sits upon his throne, a look of satisfaction on his face.

KING EVERARD
(to his advisors)
We have done it, my friends. We have created a new era for our empire. An era of... (he consults the VHS tape again)...futuristic nostalgia.

FADE TO BLACK.
